# Project or Site Name

> One sentence that describes the site, product, project, or documentation set.

Add short constraints or context only when a reader needs them to interpret the linked resources.

## Docs

- [Canonical Documentation](https://example.com/docs): Short description of the primary documentation.
- [API Reference](https://example.com/api): Short description, when applicable.

## Optional

- [Examples](https://example.com/examples): Short description when examples help the reader.
- [Changelog](https://example.com/changelog): Short description when release history helps the reader.
